The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a workstation, the function of which is to print large amounts of paper. Currently, its only use is the mass production of the generic quest-item [[flyer]]s. It provides no known advantage over its [[Printing press|predecessor]].
